_help.session: Q for standard qualifying or SQ for Sprint qualifying.
_help.push_threshold_fraction: Existing push-lap threshold relative to the fastest eligible lap. 0.02 means within 2% of that reference; the live planner applies it against the fastest active reference lap.
_help.data_root: Optional woData root override. Normally leave null.

report._help: Presentation only; changing language does not rerun analysis.
